script_text: Stop, Pisces — Neptune just flipped the script on your entire week. Mars is squaring your ruling planet Neptune in the 1st House of Self, creating fog between your water element's intuition and what's actually real. Meanwhile, Jupiter in Leo is trining your 3rd House of Communication, opening a window for a conversation you've been avoiding. If you're single, the Neptune fog may attract someone who isn't who they seem — trust your gut before you open your heart. If you're taken, a hidden conversation surfaces that shifts the entire dynamic between you. Saturn in Aquarius is activating your 10th House of Career, demanding you show up with clarity, not emotion — a decision made by Friday could reshape your professional path. Avoid signing any contract before Thursday — the Mercury-Neptune confusion is still active. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss what the stars have lined up.
